faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Gandhinagar is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application is completed before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline, or a B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A. or equivalent with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience. A minimum of 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in 10th and 12th are also required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-II role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 90,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II position in the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-II recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position will involve a Selection Test.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-II position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual job.
